| Item | Amount | Entry | Status |
|------|--------|-------|--------|
| Cirrus CDN (March service) | $3,200 | JE-00304 | Posted |
| Pinecrest Janitorial (March 28 cleaning) | $780 | JE-00305 | Posted |
| Whitcombe & Ames (March legal services) | $12,400 | JE-00306 | Pending Approval |
| **Total** | **$16,380** | | |

All three accruals were properly supported with the April-dated invoices and recorded to account 2100 (Accrued Expenses) per company policy section 5. The Whitcombe & Ames entry requires controller approval as it exceeds the USD 10,000 posting authority threshold.

The April rent from Lumen Office Leasing (USD 14,500) was correctly excluded as it relates to April services.
